title: Act: Add @game alias to game/vitest.config.ts
summary: Resolve @game to game/src in the game vitest config
description: Context: game/vitest.config.ts is only defineConfig({test:{include}}). BootScene imports @game/*. Add the alias only.
acceptance_criteria: Given the config, when read, then resolve.alias['@game'] is the absolute path of game/src
Given the config, when read, then include is still tests/**/*.test.ts

steps.action: Import fileURLToPath and URL from node:url and add resolve.alias with key @game pointing to the src directory, keeping the test.include entry
steps.code:
import { fileURLToPath, URL } from 'node:url';
export default defineConfig({ resolve: { alias: { '@game': fileURLToPath(new URL('./src', import.meta.url)) } }, test: { include: ['tests/**/*.test.ts'] } });
steps.expected: Config exposes @game alias and unchanged include
